capture_note: Uses eager_attention_forward monkeypatch; eager attention materializes [n_heads, T, T] scores. At T=32768 that is ~1.1G entries per head per layer in fp32 for the score matrix during capture — capture ONE layer at a time or use bf16 + chunked last-token-only logits to stay in memory.

recommended_hardware.1.5b@8k: 1x A10/24GB or better; CPU possible but slow

commands.build_dataset: python build_dataset.py   # edit MODEL_DEFAULT/max_tokens or parameterize; uses capture_qkv.load_model

code_changes_needed_for_long_ctx: capture_qkv.capture_prompt: add last-token-only logit path (avoid full TxT scores) — compute q_last @ K^T directly instead of relying on the captured attn matrix; the monkeypatch already keeps q,k,v so this is a post-hoc slice.
build longer prompts: extend _filler() / add real long documents to reach 8k-32k tokens.
run on CUDA: load_model already honors GPU via torch; set dtype=bf16.
